verdict.rationale: The division names one account layer up front: it publishes step-by-step videos for setting up a Premier Business Services (PBS) account and says when a PBS account is useful (frequent filers, shared staff payment access). It also states the order of filings, formation first and then tax/employer registration, before a Business Registration Certificate can be obtained. Missing for 10: an explicit pre-start statement of which accounts or credentials are mandatory versus optional for a first-time founder filing, any disclosure of identity-proofing steps, a single consolidated pre-flight checklist, and independent or hands-on confirmation that nothing surfaces mid-flow.
